The '''Office of Agricultural Export''' was an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] that controlled the planet's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] exports. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Office instructed [[Tayala Lees]] to transfer some of her crop to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
